senses.gloss:
One,Ⓒa.Ⓓeka; ‘o(ne) of two’ ekatara; ‘o(ne) of many’ ekatama; ‘only o(ne)’ ananya; ‘fixed on o(ne) object’ ananyavizaya, ananyavftti.

(sTApayati).
